title: Cucumber Cups with Yogurt and Smoked Salmon
blurb: Hollowed cucumber rounds filled with a creamy yogurt and cottage cheese mixture, topped with flaked smoked salmon and fresh chives.
steps: Cut the cucumbers into 3cm thick rounds and use a teaspoon to scoop out the seeds from each round, leaving a base at the bottom to form cups.
In a bowl, mix together the yogurt, cottage cheese, lemon juice and black pepper until smooth.
Finely chop most of the chives, reserving a small amount for garnish, and stir them into the yogurt mixture.
Flake the smoked salmon into small pieces.
Spoon the yogurt mixture into each cucumber cup, filling them generously.
Top each cup with a portion of flaked smoked salmon and scatter over the reserved chives before serving.
